text: bhante bhagavato 1 saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi . [134] rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto sārattacitto vedeti tañca ajjhosā 2 tiṭṭhati . tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā anekā rūpasambhavā abhijjhā ca vihesā ca cittamassūpahaññati evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ ārā nibbāna vuccati . saddaṃ sutvā sati muṭṭhā piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto sārattacitto vedeti tañca ajjhosā tiṭṭhati . #1 ma. yu. bhagavatā . 2 ma. yu. ajjhosa . evamuparipi . tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā anekā saddasambhavā abhijjhā ca vihesā
